name: NOAA CO-OPS Tides & Currents API

provider.name: NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services

summary: Water levels, tide predictions, currents and meteorological observations from US coastal stations.
description: The data getter returns water level, tide predictions (high/low and 6-minute), currents, wind, air and water temperature, pressure, salinity and more for roughly 3,000 stations, with datum and unit options. A separate metadata API lists stations and sensors.

rate_limit.summary: No numeric limit documented; maximum date range per request applies (31 days for 6-minute data).

coverage.geographic: US coasts, Great Lakes, some Pacific/Caribbean territories

agent_notes: Set product (water_level, predictions, currents, ...), station id, datum, time_zone and units explicitly. Use date=latest for the newest reading, and always send an application name.
caveats: Errors come back as HTTP 200 with an error object, so check the body.
The application parameter is requested for identification.
No OpenAPI spec found; a metadata API is at https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/mdapi/prod/.
